<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Secure File Storage Service
 * Implements defense-in-depth: path validation, extension whitelist,
 * content-type verification, size limits, and sandboxed storage.
 */
class PathValidator {
    private string $storageRoot;
    private array $allowedExtensions = ['jpg', 'png', 'gif', 'pdf', 'txt'];
    private int $maxFileSize = 5242880; // 5MB

    public function __construct(string $storageRoot) {
        $this->storageRoot = realpath($storageRoot);
        if ($this->storageRoot === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid storage root');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validates that the target path is within the storage root.
     * Uses realpath on the parent directory to prevent traversal.
     */
    public function validateTargetPath(string $userDir, string $filename): string {
        // Sanitize filename - remove any path separators
        $cleanFilename = basename($filename);
        
        // Validate extension
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($cleanFilename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!in_array($ext, $this->allowedExtensions, true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('File extension not allowed');
        }

        // Construct and validate the user directory path
        $targetDir = $this->storageRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . basename($userDir);
        
        // Ensure directory exists
        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            mkdir($targetDir, 0750, true);
        }

        // Resolve to real path and verify it's under storage root
        $resolvedDir = realpath($targetDir);
        if ($resolvedDir === false || strpos($resolvedDir, $this->storageRoot) !== 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Path traversal detected');
        }

        // Final target path
        $targetPath = $resolvedDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $cleanFilename;
        
        // Verify the final path is still under storage root
        // (defense in depth - check the constructed path)
        $normalizedTarget = $resolvedDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $cleanFilename;
        if (strpos($normalizedTarget, $this->storageRoot) !== 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Path traversal in filename');
        }

        return $targetPath;
    }

    public function getMaxFileSize(): int {
        return $this->maxFileSize;
    }
}

class ContentVerifier {
    private array $mimeWhitelist = [
        'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif',
        'application/pdf', 'text/plain'
    ];

    /**
     * Verifies file content matches expected type using finfo.
     */
    public function verifyContent(string $tempPath, string $expectedExt): bool {
        $finfo = new \finfo(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $detectedMime = $finfo->file($tempPath);
        
        if (!in_array($detectedMime, $this->mimeWhitelist, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Cross-check extension against detected MIME
        $extMimeMap = [
            'jpg' => ['image/jpeg'],
            'png' => ['image/png'],
            'gif' => ['image/gif'],
            'pdf' => ['application/pdf'],
            'txt' => ['text/plain'],
        ];

        $allowedMimes = $extMimeMap[$expectedExt] ?? [];
        return in_array($detectedMime, $allowedMimes, true);
    }
}

class QuotaManager {
    private PDO $db;
    private int $maxStoragePerUser = 52428800; // 50MB

    public function __construct(PDO $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function checkQuota(string $userId, int $fileSize): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) as total FROM user_files WHERE user_id = :uid'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return ($row['total'] + $fileSize) <= $this->maxStoragePerUser;
    }

    public function recordUpload(string $userId, string $filePath, int $fileSize, string $checksum): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO user_files (user_id, file_path, file_size, checksum, created_at) VALUES (:uid, :path, :size, :checksum, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':path' => $filePath,
            ':size' => $fileSize,
            ':checksum' => $checksum,
        ]);
    }
}

class SecureFileUploader {
    private PathValidator $pathValidator;
    private ContentVerifier $contentVerifier;
    private QuotaManager $quotaManager;

    public function __construct(
        PathValidator $pathValidator,
        ContentVerifier $contentVerifier,
        QuotaManager $quotaManager
    ) {
        $this->pathValidator = $pathValidator;
        $this->contentVerifier = $contentVerifier;
        $this->quotaManager = $quotaManager;
    }

    /**
     * Handles file upload with full validation pipeline.
     * 
     * Security measures:
     * - Path validation with realpath resolution
     * - Extension whitelist
     * - MIME type verification
     * - File size limits
     * - Per-user quota enforcement
     * - Content integrity verification
     */
    public function handleUpload(string $userId, array $fileData): array {
        // Validate upload data
        if (!isset($fileData['tmp_name'], $fileData['name'], $fileData['size'], $fileData['error'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid upload data');
        }

        if ($fileData['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Upload failed with error: ' . $fileData['error']);
        }

        if (!is_uploaded_file($fileData['tmp_name'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid upload source');
        }

        // Size check
        $fileSize = (int)$fileData['size'];
        if ($fileSize <= 0 || $fileSize > $this->pathValidator->getMaxFileSize()) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('File size exceeds limit');
        }

        // Validate and resolve target path
        $targetPath = $this->pathValidator->validateTargetPath($userId, $fileData['name']);

        // Verify content type
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($fileData['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!$this->contentVerifier->verifyContent($fileData['tmp_name'], $ext)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Content type mismatch');
        }

        // Check quota
        if (!$this->quotaManager->checkQuota($userId, $fileSize)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Storage quota exceeded');
        }

        // Compute checksum before write for integrity
        $checksum = hash_file('sha256', $fileData['tmp_name']);

        // Write file to validated target path
        $this->writeFile($fileData['tmp_name'], $targetPath);

        // Verify written file integrity
        $writtenChecksum = hash_file('sha256', $targetPath);
        if (!hash_equals($checksum, $writtenChecksum)) {
            unlink($targetPath);
            throw new \RuntimeException('File integrity check failed');
        }

        // Record in database
        $this->quotaManager->recordUpload($userId, $targetPath, $fileSize, $checksum);

        return [
            'status' => 'success',
            'path' => basename($targetPath),
            'size' => $fileSize,
            'checksum' => $checksum,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Writes uploaded file to target location.
     * Validates target is not a symlink before writing.
     */
    private function writeFile(string $source, string $target): void {
        // Security check: ensure target doesn't already exist as symlink
        if (is_link($target)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Target path is a symbolic link');
        }

        // Check parent directory is not a symlink
        $parentDir = dirname($target);
        if (is_link($parentDir)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Parent directory is a symbolic link');
        }

        // Move the uploaded file to the target
        if (!move_uploaded_file($source, $target)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to move uploaded file');
        }

        // Set restrictive permissions
        chmod($target, 0640);
    }
}

// Request handler
function handleRequest(): void {
    session_start();
    
    if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Authentication required']);
        return;
    }

    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
        http_response_code(405);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Method not allowed']);
        return;
    }

    // Verify CSRF token
    $csrfToken = $_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '';
    if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '', $csrfToken)) {
        http_response_code(403);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid CSRF token']);
        return;
    }

    if (!isset($_FILES['file'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'No file provided']);
        return;
    }

    try {
        $dsn = 'mysql:host=localhost;dbname=filestore;charset=utf8mb4';
        $db = new PDO($dsn, getenv('DB_USER'), getenv('DB_PASS'), [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
        ]);

        $storageRoot = getenv('STORAGE_ROOT') ?: '/var/app/storage/uploads';
        $pathValidator = new PathValidator($storageRoot);
        $contentVerifier = new ContentVerifier();
        $quotaManager = new QuotaManager($db);
        $uploader = new SecureFileUploader($pathValidator, $contentVerifier, $quotaManager);

        $result = $uploader->handleUpload($_SESSION['user_id'], $_FILES['file']);
        echo json_encode($result);

    } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Upload processing failed']);
    }
}

handleRequest();
